Name: Freefall Farm
Author: harpiediva
Description:
[size=4][b]A new farm map for those who love to feel the sun on their skin and the wind in their hair as they fall down, down, down...

Install Instructions:[/b]
[/size][size=2]After downloading the required mods, drag and drop the two folders ("[CP] FreefallFarm" and "[FTM] FreefallFarm") into "C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods" or wherever your particular Stardew Valley/Mods folder is located.

[/size][size=4][b]Tips: [/b][/size][size=2]
This mod should now be configurable to allow you to switch between farm maps. By default, it will replace the Riverland farm map. This can be changed using GMCM when you open the game. Simply open the GMCM menu, choose "FreefallFarm" and choose between the game maps. If you don't have GMCM, you can open config.json in the mod files, and replace "Riverland" with your farm layout of choice.

[/size]
[size=4][b]Recommended Mods:[/b][/size]
[size=2]Aside from the hard requirements listed above, here are some visual mods I would recommend to match the screenshot.
[/size][list]

[*][size=2][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4542]﻿Medieval Buildings[/url][/size]
[*][size=2][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8897?tab=description]Visible Fish[/url][/size]
[/list][b][size=4][size=4]
Recent Changes
[/size][/size][/b][size=4][list]
[*][size=2]Updated Bus Stop warp points to fall in line with 1.6 update.[/size]

[/list][/size][b][size=4]Upcoming Features:[/size][/b]

[/list]
